newsitem.title: INDIA: India to allow more private agriculture investment.
newsitem.headline: India to allow more private agriculture investment.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda said on Monday his government will draft a proposal in the near future to provide greater opportunity to private investors in agriculture.
Deve Gowda told an economic conference in the Indian capital that he had decided to draft an agricultural policy document "to provide the opportunity for larger private investments in agriculture."
He said more private investment in the sector was needed to ensure speedy economic growth, and the document would be ready in the "near future." He did not elaborate.
